podcast.title: Departure from Stone Canyon Band
podcast.body: Randy Meisner left Rick Nelson's Stone Canyon Band after Nelson was booed by fans at Madison Square Garden in October 1971. He then went on to help create The Eagles. "So they booed him and his long hair to the point that Randy Meisner, who would leave the band and go help create something else called the Eagles, left."
